Enter the login of your MACH app. The ma: Enter the login of your MACH app. The machId is shown in the app under device settings (12 hex characters, e.g. A1B2C3D4E5F6).
operation – heating, climate, fridge, li: operation – heating, climate, fridge, lights, pump, boiler (recommended)
setup – also sensor pairing, limits and: setup – also sensor pairing, limits and names (experts)
Writable values appear under values.* as: Writable values appear under values.* as switch, slider or selection. Names are the ones under values.*, e.g. FRIDGE_VALUE or LIGHT_GROUP_*. Values that could cut the LTE connection or brick the box (LTE on/off, SIM settings, bootloader, debug) can never be written.
